title: Grouped batch composition and single-use Arrow readers
question: Can native grouping share both checks across batch boundaries, and can DuckDB execute a reusable relation over a one-shot Arrow reader?
method: Run installed Acero and DuckDB over independent six-row Arrow readers, then exercise DuckDB reader consumption and a separate CLI plan.
commands: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 30s taskset -c 0-1 prlimit --core=0 --fsize=16777216 -- uv run --no-sync python -X faulthandler docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-22_sbx-analytical-redesign/probe.py

results.name: Engines matching independent grouping results
results.note: Two batches, five compound groups and two aggregate values per group.

results.name: Reads of the explicitly materialized relation
results.note: The direct Arrow reader refuses the second scan.

conclusion: Group multiple checks in native execution. Give a multi-consumer fork an explicit reusable representation. The synthetic control establishes library behavior.
